body:
## Changes

- **Fix `--episode-card-bg` for dark mode**: Changed the hardcoded `#fffefc` (near-white) value to `var(--light)`, so episode pages correctly adopt the dark background (`#1c1a18`) when dark mode is active. Previously, light-colored text was rendered on a white card — effectively invisible.
- **Remove invisible box-shadows in dark mode**: Added a `:root[saved-theme="dark"]` block in `custom.scss` that sets `box-shadow: none` on all card elements (center content, sidebars, explorer, footer). Dark shadows (`rgba(0,0,0,...)`) are invisible on dark backgrounds; the existing `border: 1px solid var(--lightgray)` borders already switch correctly and provide the needed visual separation.

Closes #19

comments.body: @sepo-agent /answer I was wondering if you can spin up a service and take screenshots of the webpages to show it really fixed? are we or is there a way to live deploy this?

Great question. Here's the situation on both fronts:

---

### Screenshots in CI

Taking screenshots is technically feasible here — the workflow could build the Quartz site, serve it locally, and use a headless Chromium (via Playwright or Puppeteer) to capture before/after dark mode views. However, this isn't wired up in the current CI setup, so it would require adding a dedicated step. The change itself is small (16 lines in [`quartz/styles/custom.scss`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/styles/custom.scss)):
- Fixes `--episode-card-bg` to use `var(--light)` (dark-aware) instead of a hardcoded `#fffefc`
- Adds `box-shadow: none` in dark mode so invisible shadows don't persist

If you want screenshot diffs as part of PR review, I can add a Playwright-based CI step that captures and uploads screenshots as artifacts.

---

### Live Preview / Deploy

The site publishes from **`main` via GitHub Pages** — this PR's changes won't be live until merged.

Options for **PR preview deployments**:
1. **Cloudflare Pages** (recommended, free) — connect the repo, it auto-deploys branches/PRs with unique preview URLs
2. **Netlify / Vercel** — same pattern, also free tier
3. **Local preview now** — the repo has a `Dockerfile`; run it locally to see the changes:
   ```bash
   docker build -t augmented-mind . && docker run -p 8080:8080 augmented-mind
   ```
   Then toggle dark mode in the browser at `localhost:8080`.

---

**Short answer**: merging this PR is the fastest path to seeing it live. If you want screenshot CI or a PR preview service set up, just say the word and I'll implement it.
